details:
For the better half of the past year, I thought it was a weird design quirk to not include content warnings in the new View Avatar Details since the introduction of the Avatar Marketplace. The only place to find those was in the old Avatar Details found from Quick Menu.

But the Help & Info article refers to the ability to see them in the View Avatar Details (from Main Menu?). Yet the option to see those content warnings is not there as instructed, which makes me think this may be a bug, and not a feature request to include those.

1. Open Main Menu

2. Click the "?" icon top right for Help & Info

3. Navigate to Safety group on the left

4. Click "Content Warnings" and scroll down to find photos with "Content Tags" shown in the avatar details page

5. Compare to the current Avatar Details page from Main Menu or Current Avatar with an avatar with content warnings applied

Expected result: See content warnings on the avatar details page, as instructed in Help & Info.

Actual result: Content warnings have never been part of the new View Avatar Details or Current Avatar pages in Main Menu since the introduction of the Avatar Marketplace. This includes avatars you've uploaded and the avatars of other users.

Additional info: (For whatever the reason, the avatar 3D preview is also located on the left side in the Help & Info article, while it's on the right side in live. It also refers to "Other NSFW" being an option, which isn't available. It also refers to "Content Tags" instead of "Content Warnings" seen in world tab.)

I think there's a similar tracked bug report about this somewhere in Open Beta category with a poorly worded title, but I can't find it right now.
title: View Avatar Details isn't displaying content warnings as instructed in "Content Warnings" Help & Info
